name: NGC 474 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 474, a giant elliptical galaxy wrapped in shells, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc474-hubble
story: Layered shells ripple around the core of this giant elliptical galaxy, perhaps the aftermath of it swallowing one or more smaller galaxies.

claims.text: NGC 474 is a gigantic elliptical galaxy
It is surrounded by complex layered shells
The shells may be the aftereffects of absorbing one or more smaller galaxies; the cause is unknown
The NASA release image credits D. Carter and Hubble's ACS
